Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning access to land for hunting and fishing.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting public agencies from providingspecific segments of the general public with access to land for thepurposes of hunting and fishing; adding a new section to chapter 77.12RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.17 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 79A.05 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 79.10 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 36.32 RCW; adding a new section to chapter35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35A.21 RCW; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Unless otherwise specifically authorized in statute, no publicagency, as that term is defined in RCW 42.30.020, may provide only aspecified segment or segments of the general public with access to landowned, leased, or otherwise controlled by the public agency for thepurpose of hunting or fishing without providing the same accessopportunity to the general public. This section applies to rules orregulations of the public agency, access contracts and agreements, andall other forms of express or implied access permission.

Any public agency, as that term is definedin RCW 42.30.020, that allows a specified segment or segments of thegeneral public to access land owned, leased, or otherwise controlled bythe public agency for the purpose of hunting or fishing as of theeffective date of this section must either suspend access permission tothe specified segment or segments or allow access to the generalpublic.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any department listed in RCW 43.17.010 shall comply with section 1of this act when granting access for hunting or fishing to any landowned, leased, or otherwise controlled by the department.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79A.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The commission shall comply with section 1 of this act whengranting access for hunting or fishing to any land owned, leased, orotherwise controlled by the commission for hunting or fishing access.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.10 RCWunder the subchapter heading "Multiple Use" to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall comply with section 1 of this act whengranting access for hunting or fishing to any land owned, leased, orotherwise controlled by the department.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A county shall comply with section 1 of this act when grantingaccess for hunting or fishing to any land owned, leased, or otherwisecontrolled by the county.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city shall comply with section 1 of this act when granting accessfor hunting or fishing to any land owned, leased, or otherwisecontrolled by the city.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A code city shall comply with section 1 of this act when grantingaccess for hunting or fishing to any land owned, leased, or otherwisecontrolled by the code city.
